subscription_description: Sign in with a Meta account and an active Muse Code subscription. Payment or plan eligibility is checked during login. No refresh or read-only allowance endpoint is available.
api_key_description: Paste a Meta Model API key. This does not establish Muse Code subscription eligibility; models are limited by the key's actual permissions.
compatibility: Responses streaming; function tools and encrypted reasoning are preserved. Only automatic tool selection is supported; other selections and unsupported effort tiers are omitted, losing those constraints.
